entries.da2d8b1babe87645: This is a general construction business that undertakes everything from planning and design to construction of condominiums and other buildings. The core of the business is the filing company, HASEKO Corporation, and its subsidiaries such as Fuji Kensetsu Co., Ltd., Hasek Co., Ltd. and Haseko Furnishing Co., Ltd. undertake construction contracts and sell and rent construction materials and equipment, while the filing company places orders with these affiliates for part of its operations and construction work, planning, design and supervision of condominiums and office buildings, and construction materials. Large-scale repair and interior renovation are carried out by Haseko Reform Co., Ltd., and the construction and sale of detached houses are carried out by Hosoda Komuten Co., Ltd., Haseko Home Co., Ltd., Wood Friends Co., Ltd., Forest Note Co., Ltd. and Lumber Land Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥820,088 million, up 5.3% from ¥778,746 million in the previous fiscal year, the largest of the four reportable segments. The company received orders for 64 new condominium construction projects (45 in the Tokyo metropolitan area and 19 in the Kinki and Tokai areas), of which 22 large-scale projects of 200 or more units were in the Tokyo metropolitan area and 14 were in the Kinki and Tokai areas. A total of 104 completed construction projects were finished, including 12 rental condominiums and similar buildings. For construction orders placed with the filing company on a non-consolidated basis, 91.7% were negotiated contracts (contracts in which the client designates the counterparty) and 8.3% were competitive bids, measured by contract value. The company states that its ability to gather land information, its product planning capability, its commitment to construction quality and schedules, and its efficient production system are highly regarded by project owners.
